name: ai-roblox-obby-builder
description: Deterministic-first tooling for generating native-Part Roblox Obbies.

scripts.build: tsx tools/clean-build.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsx tools/package-build.ts && npm run build:smoke
scripts.roblox:build: tsx tools/prepare-build.ts && rojo build roblox/default.project.json --output build/AIObbyBuilder.rbxlx && rojo build roblox/smoke.project.json --output build/Phase0Smoke.rbxlx && rojo sourcemap roblox/default.project.json --output build/roblox-sourcemap.json
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run contracts:check && npm run evaluator:contracts:check && npm run fixtures:check && npm run test && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:dependencies && npm run roblox:format:check && npm run roblox:lint && npm run roblox:test && npm run roblox:build
